description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the task count across various language categories, categorized by which model performed better. The horizontal axis displays the language categories, ordered from left to right as IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, a category with its label obscured by a solid grey rectangle, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents the "task count" on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 40 with numeric tick labels and corresponding horizontal grid lines at intervals of 10. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each language category. According to the legend titled "better", the groups consist of up to three bars representing "mBERT" in light blue, "XLM-R" in dark blue, and "same" in light green, with all bars outlined in black. The task counts vary across the categories and models. The shortest bars represent a task count of 0 for mBERT in the IE-Baltic and Semitic categories, where no light blue bar is visible. The tallest bar in the chart is the dark blue XLM-R bar in the obscured fifth category, reaching approximately 39. Other notable high values include the light green "same" bar for IE-Romance at exactly 30, and the light green "same" bar for the obscured category at approximately 28. The mBERT bars generally show the lowest task counts, typically ranging from 0 to 4, except in the obscured category where it reaches 12. XLM-R task counts range from approximately 5 in IE-Indic and Isolate to 39 in the obscured category. The "same" category ranges from approximately 1 in Isolate and Semitic to 30 in IE-Romance. The categories on the horizontal axis are not sorted by value but appear to follow an alphabetical grouping for the "IE-" prefixed labels followed by the remaining labels. The fifth label on the horizontal axis is visually altered, completely covered by a grey rectangle.
